we show that high accuracy can mask subtle types of model failure and we introduce methods for discovering these types of model failures.

The main takeaway from our work is that
high accuracy is a weak signal of a classifier's ability to generalize.
high scoring CNNs are not necessarily reliable, and that we must develop new metrics and techniques to assess the robustness of image classification models.
